title: lannea schimperi var. stolzii
intro: Lannea schimperi var. stolzii, commonly known as Stolz's Lannea, is a plant species of the family Anacardiaceae, native to the Horn of Africa. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Lannea schimperi var. stolzii are attributed to its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat respiratory infections. Bioactive constituents found in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
